fixturePolicy: Synthetic local storage, level-one pets sampled from each Pet.csv rarity; no player storage read. Capacity override is QA only, source capacity comes from Rebirth.csv
gaps: Fixtures cover Pet.csv normal pets at level 1; secret fusion pets, lucky boxes and special eggs are not exercised
Level-one income is derived from CSV value and additive mutation/weather multipliers; higher-level BigNumber growth/rounding is not simulated
Store/retrieve and lock age are local scenarios; no database writes or gameplay rewards
Capacity above current Rebirth.csv maximum is an explicit synthetic QA override for pagination
No engine screenshots; font/shader/scaler, hit order, safe area and scroll inertia unverified; player state is a local simulation
